incident.summary: Paid founder remains on free plan; the payment produced no system-verifiable evidence and no code path could activate it.

timeline_utc.event: intent expiry sweep marked both intents EXPIRED
founder report: payment confirmed on bank; plan still free

failure_model.mechanism: Evidence never entered any activation rail: static reference-less link + no provider rail configured; latent callback signature-format mismatch would additionally block authentic Razorpay callbacks.

latent_defect.verifyPoolSignature_message_after: payment_id|payment_link_id|reference_id|status (authentic Razorpay) with legacy reference_id:payment_id compat fallback
latent_defect.impact_if_unfixed: authentic Razorpay redirect callbacks fail invalid_signature and are permanently ledged non-activating

decisions.rationale: Grant authority requires evidence on the intent (payment_evidence=0, pool_callbacks=0). A repair write from a claim alone violates incident rules. Operator must service the founder intent via evidence or refund; this is outside the activation rail.

decisions.details: authentic Razorpay callback signature verification with legacy compat in pool/callback.ts

known_issues: control-center.test.ts router test (default 5s import timeout) can stall under concurrent batch transform load; passes solo and in the 9-file legacy batch; load sensitivity, pre-existing.
operator_remediation: provision REAL explicit pool links (unique per-link reference_id + callback_url) via PAYMENT_POOL_LINKS
set RAZORPAY_KEY_SECRET (and RAZORPAY_KEY_ID for the API rail)
optionally configure the gmail claim rail (GMAIL_OAUTH_*, PAYMENT_ACCOUNT_EMAIL)
service the existing founder intent with evidence or refund through the operator menu (no grant without evidence)
